Profile log-likelihood of one SIRD-GA parameter

Source: R/sird_ga_incidence.R
sird_ga_profile.Rd

Maximises the log-likelihood over the remaining free parameters on a grid of fixed values of param, warm-starting each grid point from the previous optimum.

Usage

sird_ga_profile(fit, cases = NULL, deaths = NULL, param, grid, maxit = 3000)

Arguments

fit

Output of sird_ga_fit_inc().

cases, deaths

Data used for fit.

param

Name of the profiled parameter (one of fit$free).

grid

Values at which to profile.

maxit

Nelder-Mead iteration limit per grid point.

Value

Data frame with value, loglik and the re-optimised parameters.
